subtitle: the Bochner–Riesz conjecture in three dimensions
summary: Bochner–Riesz multipliers of every positive order are bounded on L³(ℝ³), the key case of the three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture.
problem: The Bochner–Riesz conjecture predicts the exact range of Lᵖ boundedness for the multipliers (1 − |ξ|²)₊^δ and is one of the central open problems of Fourier restriction theory. The OpenAI preprint “Bochner–Riesz multipliers in three dimensions” (September 24, 2026) proves the three-dimensional conjecture in its strict-order formulation, whose main result is boundedness on L³(ℝ³) for every positive order (Theorem 1.1). We formalize Theorem 1.1 using LEAP, taking the planar Ren–Wang estimate (Theorem 3.1, discrete form) as an assumed result.
statement: For every δ > 0 there is a finite constant C_δ ≥ 0 such that ‖T_δ f‖_{L³(ℝ³)} ≤ C_δ ‖f‖_{L³(ℝ³)} for every Schwartz function f on ℝ³, where T_δ is the Bochner–Riesz multiplier with symbol (1 − |ξ|²)₊^δ.

notes.title: Assumed result
notes.text: Theorem 3.1 of the paper (Ren–Wang, discrete form) is stated as the axiom ren_wang, matching the statement in the paper, and is not proved here. The proof of Theorem 1.1 uses no other axioms beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

title: Bochner–Riesz Multipliers in Three Dimensions
